question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**which**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about Dr. Jill Biden: First Lady.
 
• In the fifth blank 'which' should be used.
 
• It is 'used for making a comment on what has just been said'. [(कथन के पहले भाग पर टिप्‍पणी करने के लिए प्रयुक्त, कथन के पहले भाग को दूसरे से जोड़ने के लिए प्रयुक्त) जो, और यह बात...]
 
 
• *Example: We had to wait 16 hours for our plane, **which** was really annoying.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**​**Correct Passage:__ *Dr. Jill Biden is an English professor in a college and she has four degrees, including a doctorate. She is the wife of the newly elected U.S. President, Joe Biden. As America's next first lady, the 69-year-old Jill Biden plans to keep her job and continue teaching **which** is something that she did as the second lady when her husband was the Vice President.*
